Container.Name: foliowiki
Container.Overview: Folio (foliowiki) is a git-native collaborative wiki with a built-in AI assistant and an MCP server for AI agents. Pages are plain files in a Git repository, edited together in real time, with access rights and page history.[br][br][b]Before you install:[/b] Folio needs a PostgreSQL container and a Redis (or Valkey) container. Install both from the Apps tab first (for example "postgresql17" and "Redis"), set the PostgreSQL variables POSTGRES_USER=folio, POSTGRES_PASSWORD (your choice) and POSTGRES_DB=folio, then put their addresses into DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL below.[br][br][b]PUBLIC_URL must be the exact address you open in the browser,[/b] for example http://192.168.1.10:4870. If it is empty or starts with https while you open Folio over plain http, sign-in silently fails because the session cookie is marked Secure. If you use a reverse proxy with HTTPS, set the https address instead.[br][br][b]FOLIO_SECRET[/b] encrypts saved Git tokens and AI keys. Generate it once with "openssl rand -hex 32" (Unraid terminal) and never change it afterwards.[br][br]The first account you create becomes the administrator. Allow about 2 GB of RAM for the whole stack.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: wiki knowledge base notes docs git markdown mcp llm assistant collaborative
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL 17 container (for example "postgresql17" from the Apps tab) and a Redis or Valkey container. Both must be running before Folio starts.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port of the Folio web interface. Must match the port in PUBLIC_URL.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Git repositories of your spaces, uploaded files and assistant state. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/DATABASE. Replace PASSWORD and [UNRAID-IP]. Special characters in the password must be URL-encoded.

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: Redis or Valkey address, for example redis://192.168.1.10:6379. It holds only transient data (presence, rate limits).

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The exact address you open Folio at, including the port, for example http://192.168.1.10:4870. Use https://... only behind a reverse proxy with TLS. Invite and share links are built from it.

Config.Name: FOLIO_SECRET
Config.Description: Encrypts saved Git tokens and AI keys. Generate once: openssl rand -hex 32. Never change it afterwards, or saved tokens and keys become unreadable.

Config.Name: CURSOR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. API key for the built-in AI assistant. Leave empty to turn the assistant off.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Google OAuth client ID for sign-in with Google.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated Google Workspace domains allowed to sign in.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port inside the container. Leave as 4870 and change the host port above instead.

Config.Name: ASSET_BACKEND
Config.Description: Where uploaded files are stored. Leave as local (inside Appdata).

Config.Name: CURSOR_AGENT_WORKSPACE_ROOT
Config.Description: Assistant workspaces, inside Appdata. Leave as is.

Config.Name: CURSOR_AGENT_STATE_DIR
Config.Description: Assistant state, inside Appdata. Leave as is.
